scenario.title: 冷氣壞了、熱水器不熱
scenario.context: 住進去之後，總有東西會壞。跟房東報修要講清楚：什麼壞了、從什麼時候開始、你已經試過什麼、修好了沒。這些正是現在完成式 already / yet / just 最常出場的地方。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hi Mr. Wang, sorry to bother you. The AC in the bedroom has stopped working.
lines.zh: 王先生您好，抱歉打擾。臥室的冷氣不動了。

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.en: Oh no. Have you checked the remote batteries?
lines.zh: 哎呀。你檢查過遙控器的電池了嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yes, I've already changed them. It turns on, but it's just blowing warm air.
lines.zh: 有，我已經換過了。它開得起來，但只吹熱風。

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.en: Hmm, it's been acting up since last summer. I'll call the repair guy.
lines.zh: 嗯，它從去年夏天就怪怪的。我來叫師傅。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thank you. Do you know when he can come?
lines.zh: 謝謝。您知道他什麼時候能來嗎？

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.en: I haven't heard back from him yet. I'll let you know.
lines.zh: 他還沒回我，我再跟你說。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hi Mr. Wang, just checking in. Has the repair guy gotten back to you yet?
lines.zh: 王先生您好，跟您確認一下。師傅回覆您了嗎？

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.en: Sorry, I haven't gotten around to calling him again. I've been so busy.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我還沒空再打給他，最近太忙了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I understand, but it's been a week and it's 34 degrees in my room.
lines.zh: 我理解，但已經一個禮拜了，我房間有 34 度。

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.en: You're right. I'll sort it out today, I promise.
lines.zh: 你說得對，我今天就處理，我保證。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thanks. Oh, and the water heater has been on the fritz too. The water only gets lukewarm.
lines.zh: 謝謝。對了，熱水器也怪怪的，水只會溫溫的。

lines.speaker: Landlord
lines.en: Got it. I've just texted him about both. He says he can come tomorrow at 10.
lines.zh: 了解。我剛剛傳訊息跟他說了兩件事，他說明天十點可以來。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Perfect, I'll be home. Thank you!

patterns.en: It's been making a weird noise.
patterns.zh: 它一直發出奇怪的聲音。

patterns.en: There's a leak under the sink.
Has anyone gotten back to you yet?

patterns.note: 追進度時的禮貌開頭，不會顯得在催

patterns.en: When would be a good time for him to come?
Thanks for sorting it out so quickly.

chinglish.wrong: The air conditioner is broken already one week.
chinglish.right: The AC has been broken for a week.
chinglish.why: 中文「已經壞一個禮拜了」的「已經」不能直翻成 already。表示持續多久要用現在完成式 + for。
美式口語 Did… already? 其實也聽得到，但問「到底來了沒」時，Has… yet? 是最標準的說法。
有明確過去時間（yesterday）就只能用過去式。現在完成式不能搭配明確的過去時間點。

chinglish.wrong: The water is not hot, it is warm warm.
chinglish.why: 「溫溫的」英文是 lukewarm，不能用疊字。

grammar.title: 現在完成式入門 already / yet / just
grammar.oneLiner: 現在完成式（have + p.p.）講的是「過去的事對現在的影響」：做完了沒、做了沒。
whenToUse: just：剛剛才完成。I've just texted him.
already：已經完成（常常比預期早）。I've already changed the batteries.
yet：問句和否定句，「了沒／還沒」。Has he called yet? / He hasn't called yet.
位置：just 和 already 放在 have 和 p.p. 中間；yet 放句尾。
注意：句子裡有 yesterday、last week、in 2023 這種明確時間時，要改用過去式。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文用「了」「過」「已經」「還沒」標示完成，動詞形態不變，而且可以跟任何時間詞一起用：「我昨天已經修好了」。英文的現在完成式卻不能和明確的過去時間放在一起，因為它的重點是「現在的狀態」而不是「什麼時候發生」。台灣人最常犯的錯就是 I have done it yesterday。

examples.correct: I've just sent you the photos.
examples.note: 剛剛才發生，just 放中間。

examples.correct: Have you called the landlord yet?
examples.incorrect: Have you called the landlord already yet?
examples.note: 問句用 yet 放句尾就好。
英式一定用現在完成式；美式口語偶爾聽到 didn't…yet，但考試和書寫用 hasn't…yet。

examples.correct: I fixed the door last night.
examples.incorrect: I've fixed the door last night.
examples.note: 有明確時間 last night，用過去式。

examples.correct: The repair guy has already left.
examples.note: already 放 has 和 left 中間。

quiz.question: Have you paid the rent ___?
quiz.explanation: 問句問「了沒」用 yet，放句尾。

quiz.question: Which is correct?
quiz.explanation: 有 yesterday 要用過去式。

quiz.question: Don't worry, I've ___ locked the door. (已經)
quiz.explanation: already 放在 have 和 p.p. 中間。

quiz.question: A: Where's Tom? B: He's ___ left. You missed him by a minute.

slang.usage: 機器時好時壞：My laptop is acting up. 也可用在身體：My back is acting up again.

risk.note: 中性好用，報修時很自然。

examples.en: The Wi-Fi has been acting up all morning.
examples.zh: Wi-Fi 整個早上都怪怪的。

examples.en: My knee acts up whenever it rains.
examples.zh: 每次下雨我的膝蓋就不舒服。

slang.usage: 美式口語，形容電器壞掉或運作不正常。

risk.note: 有點老派但仍常用，年輕人也聽得懂。

examples.en: The microwave is on the fritz again.
Sorry I didn't call. My phone's been on the fritz.
examples.zh: 抱歉沒打給你，我手機最近怪怪的。

slang.meaning: 終於抽空去做（拖了一陣子的事）
slang.usage: get around to + V-ing。常用否定：I haven't gotten around to it yet（還沒空去做）。

risk.note: 工作上也能用，但聽起來有點「一直拖」，自己說時要小心。

examples.en: I finally got around to cleaning my closet.
examples.zh: 我終於抽空整理衣櫃了。

examples.en: Sorry, I haven't gotten around to reading your email yet.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我還沒空看你的信。

slang.usage: sort something out / sort out something。英式特別常用，美式也很普遍。

examples.en: Don't worry, we'll sort it out.
I need to sort out my taxes this weekend.
